messages.content: "boundary testing" ei jinista relationship e ki mane, first time shunlam

It's when someone deliberately pushes past a stated limit to see if it actually gets enforced or if you'll let it slide. Eta subtle hote pare, jemon je jinis niye tumi already "na" bolecho, seta abar indirectly try kora.
tahole ei rokom hole ki kora uchit?
Consistently enforce koro boundary ta, prottekbar - exception dile signal jai j boundary ta flexible. Jodi repeated hoy despite clear communication, seta respect er ekta bigger issue represent kore.
